Wonderful meal at D'Maris Buffet.
Mar 2025 • Solo
I decided to " splurge", in Vietnamese terms, and try this buffet in Saigon. The locale is stunning. The food was amazing, and contrary to other buffets, you did not have to stand in line for them to replenish favorites like crab and jumbo shrimp. If I would have wanted to take a teaspoon of each item I would have needed an extra two days, and an extra stomach. 
The only disappointment were the desserts. Especially the "icecream " which was flavourless icemilk, if it was milk. 
Overall, I would recommend and will return.

Best place to enjoy buffet Korean style & celebrate your holidays
Mar 2019 • Couples
First time at D'Maris, I came to the branch in District 2. It was far from my home but very worthy. The view was nice, looking to the building and highway outside. The restaurant was in a private floor of the big mall with private space too. It was spacious with nice decoration. I was welcomed very well by the staff, with reserved table and nice table standee.
There were a lot of food & drink choices. I've been mostly impressed by their cake & cookies area (so marvelous). The best food choice is their secret beefsteak recipes. My husband had the second time here so he said the shrimp was good to but regretly, it was not served on the day we came there.
There were plenty choices of cake & cookies so I just tried some cheesecake, they were tasty but quite fat and sweet to me. Another thing to remind was the area of self-reserved drinks, there was an auto machine which I can have some milk cocoa or milk coffee. The taste was not bad.
Finally about the reception, they had the responsibility to make the payments, they were okey and I also took some Korean magazine for free there (at the place print notices kept). Price was high at that time and softer nowadays but worth it, try once or sometimes to change your favour.

Good Selection !
Sep 2018 • Friends
My friend brought me to D'Maris for a dinner buffet over the weekend. This restaurant is about 35 mins away from the city. It is on the 6th floor of the Cantavil Parkson. The shopping center is in a state of decline. Except for the Big C Supermarket in the basement, there is hardly anyone in the building. The restaurant itself is quite crowded over the weekend. Price per person is about US$25. There is a larger selection of food. Seafood is good and so are the desserts. Quite a good place to bring the family. It is popular amongst the locals and Korean expats in District 2.
